question: When difference between compound and simple interest for three years is ₹186 at 10% interest per annum, the principal is ₹______
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective SI for 3 years at 10% = 10% × 3 = 30%

Effective CI for 3 years at 10% = 33.1%

Difference = 33.1% − 30% = 3.1%

Given 3.1% of Principal = 186

⇒ Principal = (186 ÷ 3.1) × 100 = 6000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6000.**
